headline: common-people climbs from 94th to 30th on ARC-3

sections.text: common-people-whereIsMyFuckingPrize gained 3.44 points to reach 37.07, moving from 94th to 30th on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.
The climb carries the team into the top 30 as the board added 43 teams in the past day.
